capabilities: Sort open tasks under a ### Open heading
Sort completed tasks under a ### Completed heading
Trigger sorting on save when a %% ToDoList %% marker is present
Preserve non-task text at the top of the file
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a standalone to-do manager; it only rewrites notes to group existing checklists into two sections.
extras: The README warns that the plugin rewrites the entire file and does not support nested or indented lists; it was not yet approved at the time of writing, with manual installation instructions provided.
motivation: The README's 'Why this plugin?' section says the author wanted to keep notes with many checklists organized without manual sorting.
problem: In notes with many checklists it is easy to lose track of what is done versus not done, and sorting tasks by hand means constant dragging.
summary: Checklist sorter that automatically moves unfinished tasks under a ### Open heading and completed tasks under ### Completed in marked notes.
